desc:
I suppose both are related to the moon thematically – one being an outright moon rabbit, while the other has moon motifs though no confirmed relation so far with its inhabitants.

Wait... isn't there one [**White Rabbit**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_Rabbit) who has a watch? 🤔 Though with this angle, Tewi would make a stronger candidate. Sakuya × Tewi, huh...
